Graph-Wrapped Article

Some publishing platforms (WordPress plugins, Yoast SEO, many static site generators) emit JSON-LD as a top-level @graph array rather than a bare Article object, bundling the WebSite, breadcrumb, and Article nodes together. This file probes whether the date extractor descends into @graph to find the Article's datePublished (2020-09-10) instead of giving up because the root object isn't directly typed Article.
